# @cortex-ui/code-view-tree

The code view's file tree: changed files with counts, or all files; filter.

- **Plugin id:** `code-view.tree`
- **Slot:** `code.tree@1`
- **Build:** `npm run build` → `dist/` (`index.js`, `style.css`, `manifest.json`)
- **Test:** `npm test`

React, ReactDOM and `@cortex/sdk` are peer dependencies the workbench provides.

<!-- slot-contract:start (generated by ui/scripts/readme-contracts.mjs) -->
## Slot contract

- **Fills:** `code.tree@1` as `code-view.tree`
- **Props:** none besides `slot`
- **Hosts:** no slots
- **Workbench state read:** `code.base`, `code.collapse`, `code.open`, `code.options`, `code.scope`, `code.target`, `projectId`, `sessionId`
- **Workbench state written:** `code.open`, `code.options`
- **Own durable state (survives hot swaps):** `collapsed`, `expanded`, `filter`
- **Frame methods called:** `agents.list`, `tools.files`, `vcs.diff`, `vcs.status`
- **Topics followed:** `agents.changed`, `tools.files_changed`, `vcs.changed`

Styles use the theme's tokens and primitives only (`ui/verify/tokens.mjs` checks). Nothing is
imported from the renderer or from another plugin: the package builds alone (`ui/verify/standalone.mjs`).
<!-- slot-contract:end -->
